name: Can I clean mold from my air vents myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean mold from my air vents myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You might be able to clean minor, superficial mold growth visible on vent covers with household cleaners. However, if the moldy smell persists or if you suspect mold is deeper inside the ductwork or HVAC unit, DIY cleaning is not recommended. Improper cleaning can spread spores, and you may not address the root cause or fully remove hidden mold. Professional services are equipped to safely and thoroughly handle internal mold contamination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor, visible mold on vent covers might be DIY cleaned, but extensive or hidden mold requires professional help to prevent spreading spores and ensure proper removal.
